checks.name: App landing page rendered
checks.detail: Static homepage should render the app mode chooser, not README content.

checks.name: Production lab is hidden by default
checks.detail: Extractor Lab should be dev-only unless NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_EXTRACTOR_LAB=true.

checks.name: Callback route renders in static export
checks.detail: out/auth/callback/index.html should exist and render the client callback shell.

checks.name: Sign-in link failure has friendly recovery copy
checks.detail: Callback should hide raw Supabase errors and offer login, guest mode, and resend recovery.

checks.name: No raw Supabase PKCE message in callback UI
checks.detail: Users should never see the raw Supabase verifier-storage error.

checks.name: Login uses password flow
checks.detail: Normal login should use email/password, not passwordless email links.

checks.name: Signup uses email/password flow
checks.detail: Signup should create an email/password account and support resend if confirmation is enabled.

checks.name: Resend verification uses Supabase signup resend
checks.detail: Resend should use Supabase signup verification email, not passwordless login.

checks.name: Email and password fields render
checks.detail: Login and signup pages should render normal email/password inputs.

checks.name: Guest mode remains visible
checks.detail: Auth should never block guest usage.

checks.name: Google login hidden
checks.detail: Google auth is paused and should not appear in the launch UI.

checks.name: Logged-in dashboard does not show guest badge
checks.detail: Dashboard should show Synced workspace for authenticated users and avoid hardcoded guest badges.

checks.name: Guest dashboard still shows guest badge
checks.detail: Guest users should still see guest mode and save-progress prompts.

checks.name: Sidebar email and guest state stay consistent
checks.detail: A placeholder guest user should not carry an email, and the shell should branch display on isGuest.

checks.name: No stale guest fallback while session is loading
checks.detail: Auth provider should wait for getSession/onAuthStateChange instead of timing out into guest mode.

checks.name: Guest import uses neutral local-save copy
checks.detail: Normal guest imports should be described as local saves, not account-sync failures.

checks.name: Logged-in import uses synced workspace copy
checks.detail: Authenticated users should see synced-workspace import copy.

checks.name: No-semester import can create semester inline
checks.detail: Import modal should not send users away when they need a semester first.

checks.name: Import failures keep exact details in console
checks.detail: User-facing import failures should stay friendly while console keeps debug context.

checks.name: Details modal is viewport-scrollable
checks.detail: Course detail modal should scroll inside the viewport and keep the action rail reachable.

checks.name: Details modal supports lower assessment rows
checks.detail: PHYS 121-style templates with many rows should render all mapped assessments, including lower rows.

checks.name: Desktop sidebar stays fixed to viewport
checks.detail: Shared app pages such as Course Library should keep the sidebar bottom actions visible while main content scrolls.

checks.name: Sidebar account text truncates safely
checks.detail: Long user emails and nav labels should not overflow the sidebar.

checks.name: Simple calculator sidebar uses same viewport shell
checks.detail: The standalone GPA calculator shell should follow the same desktop sidebar behavior.

checks.name: Simple PDF extraction has no storage upload
checks.detail: Simple Mode should read PDFs locally and never upload them during normal extraction.

checks.name: Workspace PDF extraction has no storage upload
checks.detail: Workspace extraction should read PDFs locally and never upload them during normal extraction.

checks.name: Confirm save clears PDF state
checks.detail: Saving reviewed PDF extraction should discard file state and show the privacy confirmation.

checks.name: Verified feedback saves JSON/hash by default
checks.detail: Raw extracted text should be stored only when the user checks the opt-in box.

checks.name: Contribute syllabus is the only PDF storage exception
checks.detail: Only contribution review flow may ask to store syllabus source files.

checks.name: Storage cleanup dry-run exists
checks.detail: storage:cleanup-syllabi should default to dry-run and require --confirm to delete files.
